reapingArc.note: arc melee that hits with both weapons

flameBolt.note: fire projectile that explodes and can ignite

emberInfusion.note: gain physical damage as extra fire damage (the reference gem does the same)

focusedRuin.note: more spell damage, no spell crits

kindle.note: chance to ignite plus ignite damage; no exact 3.9 match

brittleDoom.note: A curse cast on a target and the enemies around it for about nine to eleven seconds: their elemental resistances fall by 20% to 39%. One curse at a time, unless the character can hold more; bosses take a third less.

leadenLimbs.note: A curse cast on a target and the enemies around it for five to six seconds: normal and magic enemies act 20% to 29% more slowly (rare and unique ones half as much), and effects on them, such as bleeds, run out 40% more slowly.

feebleGrip.note: A curse cast on a target and the enemies around it: normal and magic enemies deal 21% to 30% less damage (rare and unique ones about half as much), with less accuracy, 25% less critical strike chance and a smaller critical multiplier.

openWounds.note: A curse cast on a target and the enemies around it: they take 30% to 39% more physical damage, and more physical damage over time, and attacks have a 20% chance to make them bleed and a 20% chance to maim them.

venomSeed.note: Adds chaos damage to every hit of the supported skill, scaling with gem level.

rimeSeed.note: Adds cold damage to every hit of the supported skill, scaling with gem level.

sparkSeed.note: Adds a wide spread of lightning damage to every hit of the supported skill.

keenEye.note: Adds flat accuracy rating to the supported attack.

rendingThirst.note: More melee physical damage against bleeding enemies, and the skill can no longer cause bleeding.

deepChill.note: Increases the effect of the chill the supported skill inflicts, and chilled enemies take more cold damage.

bluntIntent.note: A large more multiplier to physical damage, at the price of every other damage type.

ricochet.note: The supported projectile chains twice, at reduced damage.

frostbreaker.note: The supported skill's hits penetrate cold resistance.

tinderbox.note: A chance to ignite, and more fire damage.

mercyStroke.note: Hits kill enemies left at 10% life or less.

freshVigour.note: More damage while the character is on full life.

knifeRange.note: More melee damage against nearby enemies (the buff on kill is dropped).

lingeringCruelty.note: More damage from ailments, less from the hit itself.

slowRot.note: Hits inflict a long poison-like damage over time (modelled as a certain, long poison).

patientPower.note: More spell damage and more damage over time.

swiftFlight.note: Faster projectiles that also deal more projectile damage.

ashbreaker.note: The supported skill's hits penetrate fire resistance.

bulwarkStrikes.note: Melee hits fortify the character, and the supported skill deals more melee damage.

tideGathering.note: Casting the supported spell grants Arcane Tide, a short buff of spell damage, cast speed and mana regeneration (the mana-spent threshold is dropped).

staggerResolve.ref: Endurance Charge on Melee Stun Support
staggerResolve.note: Stunning with the supported melee skill grants a Grit charge.

exaltedFocus.note: Raises the level of the supported skill.

driftingStorm.note: A slow orb of lightning that keeps striking the area around it (modelled as a zone that pulses for two seconds).

quiverRush.note: A short preparation, then five projectiles loosed one after another, a little off line; because they come in sequence, every one of them can hit the same enemy.

flurryOfEdges.note: A channelled flurry: the character keeps striking, each strike building a stage worth 20% more damage (six at most); when it lets go it makes one more strike for each stage built, each at the full bonus.

orbitingBlades.note: Blades orbit the caster and cut everything near (modelled as a nova that repeats every cast).

rainOfSteel.note: Volleys of blades rain on an area (modelled as a zone that pulses five times).

whirlwindCleave.note: A spinning attack around the character (the storm and stance are dropped).

emberDownpour.note: Arrows rain on an area as fire (all physical converted to fire, with fire penetration).

witheringBreath.note: A channelled breath of chaos in front of the character (the stacking debuff is averaged into short ticks).

torchArrow.note: A fire arrow that ignites harder than most.

acidArrow.note: A chaos arrow that bursts and poisons (the lasting cloud is folded into the poison).

viperLash.note: A poisonous projectile that chains between enemies, from a dagger or a claw.

suddenFrost.note: A burst of cold at the target that leaves chilled ground for five seconds, growing to twice its size, that hurts with cold; a kill on it has a 25% chance to give a Fervour charge. It waits three seconds, unless a Fervour charge is spent.

creepingPlague.note: A chaos cloud that eats at everything in it (the spread on death is dropped).

pyreBurst.note: Fire erupts in an area for several seconds (the corpse is not needed here).

judgementTempest.note: A channelled storm: each use builds a stage and zaps the enemies nearby for half damage (a crowd builds stages faster); letting go fires a beam in front of the character that hits harder for every stage built.

twinCut.note: Two fast strikes with a melee weapon, with a chance to bleed.

twinBlades.note: Strikes with both weapons at once, with more critical chance; dual wielding only.

quickeningShot.note: A fast bow or wand attack that grants a Fervour charge on hit and is stronger and faster for each charge held.

rimeSplinter.note: A melee strike; when it lands, cold blades fly out from behind the enemy it struck, at the others near it.

primalStrike.note: An attack that deals only elemental damage, added from all three elements, with a chance to freeze, shock or ignite (the random element is averaged).

ghostBlades.note: A wide fan of ten knives in front of the caster.

fuseArrow.note: A fire arrow that sticks and then explodes (the fuse is folded into an immediate burst).

emberHail.note: Flaming bolts rain over an area for two seconds.

scorchWave.note: A surge of flame in front of the caster that hits burning enemies harder.

furnaceRoar.note: A channelled blast of fire around the caster: each use builds a stage without hitting; when the channel ends, or ten stages are built, one explosion goes off whose damage and area grow with the stages.

chillingShard.note: A short-lived cold projectile that pierces and freezes (the fading is folded into the damage).

faultline.note: A heavy slam that cracks the ground; a second later it erupts in an aftershock over a wider area for 70% more damage.

sapBolt.note: A chaos projectile that leaves a draining damage over time and heals the caster from it.

kindledFrost.note: Half of the cold damage is converted to fire, and some more cold damage is added as fire.

deepWinter.note: More damage against chilled enemies, more cold damage over time, and a stronger chill.

wildfireSpread.note: A chance to freeze, shock and ignite on hit (the spreading to nearby enemies is dropped).

splitShot.note: The supported projectile forks into two the first time it hits an enemy and does not pierce it; the pair fly on past it, away from each other.

wideSalvo.note: Four more projectiles fired side by side, in lanes, at the cost of less projectile damage.

arrowTempest.note: The shot goes up and lands at the target place; four more arrows then fly out from it in a ring.

glacierDart.note: A slow cold projectile that pierces everything in its path.

stormQuill.note: A volley of three short-lived arrows, half lightning; each shot also releases one lightning burst in a cone in front of the shooter that hits every enemy in it.

rimeSpires.note: Icicles burst from the ground in a line of five bursts (modelled as a zone along the cast line).

rimeMallet.note: A heavy cold-converted strike that chills and may freeze (the shatter on the third hit is dropped).

quakeBlow.note: A slam that makes a shockwave in front of the character, with more damage close in.

frostSunder.note: A slam in three stages that is half cold (the stages are averaged).

frostRing.note: A ring of frost that expands from the caster and deals more to chilled enemies.

frostQuill.note: A cold-converted arrow that chills more strongly than usual (the cone behind the target is dropped).

blazeStream.note: A channelled torrent of fire in a cone: each use builds a stage (eight at most), 25% more damage and a wider, longer cone; when the channel ends, a final wave across the whole cone for much more damage.

cinderBlow.note: A strike that is half fire and builds a charged debuff that explodes (the explosion is folded into extra damage).

twinSlash.note: Two slashes of force in a wide arc, with a chance to bleed.

hurledSteel.note: A thrust that throws a main blade that impales, with four lesser shards.

rimeCore.note: A cold crystal that stands for two seconds: its pulses leave enemies near it exposed to cold (25% less resistance) and regenerating 75% less for five seconds; then it bursts, and the burst is the only hit. It waits two and a half seconds.

scatterBolt.note: A wand shot that bursts into four smaller bursts at the target (the clusters are folded into one burst).

stormArrow.note: An arrow that is half lightning and arcs to up to three other enemies near the target, with a stronger shock.

boltCleave.note: A melee strike; when it lands, bolts of lightning fly out from the weapon in an arc, each hitting for three quarters of the strike.

crackleRing.note: A channelled pulse of lightning around the caster that grows every fourth pulse (the larger pulse is averaged).

slagBlow.note: A melee strike, mostly fire; when it lands, molten balls are thrown to the ground around the enemy and burst there, each for half the strike.

tempestMote.note: A slow orb that calls down lightning bolts around it for six seconds.

spearBurst.note: Spears of force burst from the ground in front of the character (the stance is dropped).

venomStrike.note: A strike that is half chaos with a good chance to poison, and bursts the poison on nearby enemies (the burst is dropped).

mindDrain.note: A wand volley that culls weak enemies and gains Insight charges from strong ones.

gougeShot.note: A stab or shot that always bleeds, with the bleed lasting eight seconds.

arrowShower.note: A wide volley that falls on an area (modelled as a ground zone that pulses once).

sweepingCut.note: A sweep of the weapon in a frontal arc: each use that hits builds a stage, 50% more area (four at most); with nothing hit for three seconds the stages fade, one a second.

searingLance.note: A channelled ray of fire that burns longer on the same target and lowers fire resistance (the stacks are averaged).

splinterVolley.note: Throws a spread of steel shards that hit hardest up close, with a chance to impale; an enemy can be hit by several of the shards of one throw (one of two skills that can).

staticRing.note: Two rings of lightning that expand from the caster, with a stronger shock.

skitterFlash.note: A cloud of erratic sparks that fly in all directions for two seconds.

phantomToss.note: Throws a spectral weapon that flies out and back, hitting on both legs.

chargedBlow.note: A heavy strike that is mostly lightning and zaps nearby enemies for four seconds (the zaps are averaged).

skyfall.note: Calls bolts of lightning down on the area around the caster for 1.5 seconds (the delayed second strike is dropped).

ruptureLine.note: A slam that sends a shockwave forward with a weaker second wave (the waves are averaged).

rimeDrift.note: A slow cold projectile that leaves a field of frost where it ends (modelled as a short zone at its end).

anvilDrop.note: A counter-attack the character cannot use on purpose: when it is hit, there is a chance it strikes every enemy around it; it waits 1.2 seconds between strikes.

snareShot.note: An arrow that snares what it hits: a snared enemy moves 40% more slowly (up to three snares) and takes 15% to 20% more damage from projectile attacks.

glacierWall.note: A wall of ice across the way for three to five seconds: nothing walks through it; what stood under it is hit and pushed back. It waits three seconds between casts.

rimeRebuke.note: A shield swipe that is half cold, in a wide arc (the retaliation condition is dropped).

haloSweep.note: A sweeping attack of lightning in a wide arc.

clusterBolt.note: A wand shot that bursts into a large cluster of physical bursts.

cleansingBlaze.note: A burst of holy fire that leaves consecrated ground for four seconds (life regeneration for the character on it, better chances to crit what stands on it).

slagLob.note: A fire projectile that chains between enemies, bursting at each.

blightHail.note: A channelled bow skill: each use builds a stage (five at most) without shooting; when the channel ends, one piercing chaos arrow flies for 150% more damage for every stage built (the spore pods that bloom into thorn arrows along its path are not modelled).

spiritSaw.note: A slow, spinning chaos projectile that eats at what it hits and returns the caster's energy shield.

ghostCoil.note: A spectral weapon that flies out in a spiral and comes back (modelled as a returning projectile).

ghostShard.note: Throws spectral shards of the shield, hitting harder the more armour and evasion the shield has (the scaling is averaged).

brimstoneStorm.note: A channelled storm that fires jumping lightning orbs around the caster (averaged into repeated bursts).

bladeWind.note: A flurry of blade-wind strikes in all directions (the retaliation condition is dropped).

magmaCrack.note: A slam, mostly fire: each use has a 35% chance to spend a Grit charge for a Charged Slam, 60% more damage over more ground.

whirlShot.note: A piercing arrow flies to the target place; on arriving it scatters three arrows in all directions.

venomShower.note: Arrows rain on an area as a poisonous cloud (modelled as a zone with poison on every pulse).

toxinCircle.note: A spinning projectile that poisons and returns, hitting on both legs.

guardedStrike.note: A weighty blow that fortifies the character: used once every four seconds, or again at once by spending an Endurance-style (Grit) charge.

blizzardRing.note: A slow expanding vortex of frost around the caster that chills for several seconds.

tideOfJudgement.note: A wave of physical force, a quarter of it turned to fire and a quarter to lightning; each enemy it hits is exposed to the element it took the most damage from (25% less resistance for four seconds).

primeSplash.note: A strike that carries a random element and fires that element's projectiles from the target (averaged over the elements).

hoarfrostMote.note: A channelled orb of cold that grows stronger the longer it is held (averaged), pulsing around the caster.

rotTouch.note: A chaos spell that does no damage itself: while enemies are near it goes on hindering them (30% to 36% slower) and withering them, each stack making them take 6% more chaos damage, up to fifteen stacks.

frostFang.note: A chance to freeze, added cold damage that grows with the Fervour charges held, and a chance to gain a Fervour charge on killing a frozen enemy.

skewer.note: The supported attack impales, with a stronger impale and more physical damage.

crueltyEdge.note: A flat increase in critical strike multiplier.

livewire.note: Adds lightning damage, with a chance to shock (the buff after killing a shocked enemy is dropped).

firmHold.note: More projectile damage for projectile attacks (the keystone effect is dropped).

steelResolve.note: More spell damage (the keystone effect is dropped).

stormbreaker.note: The supported skill's hits penetrate lightning resistance.

siphonDraught.note: Attacks leech mana from the damage they deal.

tripleCadence.note: The supported melee attack strikes three times, faster, with the later strikes stronger and the whole at somewhat less damage.

galvanise.note: Half of the physical damage is converted to lightning, and some more physical is gained as lightning.

closeQuarters.note: More projectile damage (the keystone range effect is dropped).

glimpseOfCrit.note: Critical strikes may grant an Insight charge, and the skill deals more damage for each charge held.

wideCrush.note: Melee skills hit a larger area and harder, but a little slower.

lingeringShots.note: Slower projectiles that deal more damage.

hastenedRot.note: More damage over time, but ailments last a little less.

freedRot.note: Ailments last longer and deal more damage.

cruelFlight.note: More physical damage and damage over time for projectile attacks, a little slower.

foulBrew.note: Poison deals more damage, and hits deal more for each poison on the target.

voidTwist.note: More chaos damage, less elemental damage.

twinSalvo.note: Two more projectiles fired side by side with the others (the front is wider; the projectiles of one use still cannot hit the same enemy twice), for slightly less damage.

witherMark.note: Gains physical damage as chaos, and a hit can wither the target: each stack, up to fifteen, makes it take 6% more chaos damage for two seconds.

tripleShot.note: Two more projectiles, quicker, at the cost of less damage.

bloodRefund.note: Attacks gain life for each enemy hit.

festeringCrit.note: More critical strike chance, and ailments from critical strikes deal more damage over time.

mercilessCadence.note: Every third melee hit deals far more damage (averaged over the three hits).

chargedBreath.note: More damage for channelled skills (the barrier that cuts damage taken is dropped).

tinderCurse.note: A curse cast on a target and the enemies around it: their fire resistance falls (25% to 44%). Used by the AI on packs and rare enemies, one curse at a time.

rimeCurse.note: A curse that lowers the cold resistance of the enemies it falls on (25% to 44%).

staticCurse.note: A curse that lowers the lightning resistance of the enemies it falls on (25% to 44%).

voidCurse.note: A curse cast on a target and the enemies around it: their chaos resistance falls by 20% to 29%, they take 15% to 25% more damage over time, and hits against them add chaos damage.

penance.note: A curse cast on a target and the enemies around it: they have 20% less physical damage reduction, and a melee hit against one makes you a Punisher (30% more melee physical damage, 15% more attack speed) for nine seconds.

ruinRitual.note: A curse that lowers chaos resistance and makes enemies take more damage (the curses it spreads on death are dropped).

ruinSigil.note: A mark: hits against the marked enemy have a higher critical strike chance and multiplier; killing it restores 16 to 25 life and mana and has a 21% to 30% chance to give an Insight charge.

plentySigil.note: A mark: the marked enemy has 30% to 49% less evasion; attack hits against it give life and mana back; killing it doubles the flask charges gained and has a 21% to 30% chance to give a Fervour charge.

huntSigil.note: A mark: the character deals more projectile damage with more accuracy to the marked, which also take more damage.

warlordSigil.note: A mark: the marked enemy is 10% likelier to be stunned and stays stunned longer; your attack hits leech 2% of their damage as life and as mana; killing it has a 21% to 30% chance to give a Grit charge.

steadfastBellow.note: A warcry cast when a pack or a rare enemy is near: it regenerates life and grants Grit charges (the scaling with nearby enemies is averaged).

rallyingRoar.note: A warcry cast when a pack or a rare enemy is near: more damage and mana regeneration for a few seconds (the allies' share is folded into the character's).

kindledBellow.note: A warcry cast when a pack or a rare enemy is near: it hinders the enemies around the character, more with each other enemy nearby, and makes them burst for a share of their own life if they die while it lasts. Warcries wait four seconds on one another.

standardOfValour.note: A banner that gives more accuracy and the character's speed and damage a lift for as long as it stands (modelled as a timed buff, recast when it ends; the stages are averaged).

standardOfDread.note: A banner that makes the character's hits impale and gives a fortifying effect (modelled as a timed buff of impale chance and less damage taken from hits).

ironHide.note: A guard: when life is low, the character takes much less damage from hits for a few seconds (the absorb limit is folded into a flat reduction), then waits for the cooldown.

slagCarapace.note: A guard: for a few seconds the character takes less damage from hits (the share absorbed and reflected as fire is folded into the reduction).

deathlessCall.note: A guard cast when life is low: for a second the character takes much less damage, longer and with much less physical damage for each Grit charge it spends (up to five). It waits three seconds, and other guards wait with it.

bloodSurgeCall.note: A buff kept up while enemies are near: faster attacks and life leech (the life drain and frenzy charge on kill are dropped).

rampage.note: A buff cast when a pack or a rare enemy is near: more attack damage, speed and movement, and less damage taken (the rage threshold and loss are dropped).

quickStep.note: A blink: the character jumps toward a target that is out of reach (cooldown 2 seconds).

cinderStep.note: A blink toward the target (the burning ground left behind is dropped).

rimeStep.note: A blink toward the target (the chilling ground and the cooldown recovery from nearby enemies are dropped).

boltStep.note: A warp toward the target (the shocking markers it leaves are dropped).

shadowSwap.note: A blink toward the target (the corpse and the explosion it triggers are dropped).

slipstream.note: A buff of movement speed and more melee physical damage, kept up in fights.

rotStride.note: A buff of movement speed that leaves the enemies near open to chaos (the withered stacks are folded into chaos penetration; the dash is dropped).

skyfallLeap.note: A leap to the target that lands in a slam; stuns enemies on full life.

bulwarkRush.note: A charge with a shield to the target that hits harder the farther it ran.

spinningDash.note: A whirling dash through the target, hitting once along the way.

twisterBlade.note: A channelled spin around the character: it cannot be stunned while it spins; each use builds a stage (more area), and the first hit deals half.

blinkingCut.note: A strike that carries the character to the target. It waits two seconds between uses, unless a Fervour charge is spent; it gains Fervour charges on hit, attacks faster for each, and speeds the character for three seconds after each use.

stormRush.note: A dash through the target that ends in a lightning burst (the stages while channelling are averaged).

blessedTrail.note: A slam that carries the character to the target; it is half fire and leaves consecrated ground for four seconds: the character regenerates life on it and hits against enemies on it crit twice as often.

snagLash.note: A hooked strike that reaches far and gains rage when it hits.

quickeningHalo.note: An aura that reserves mana and quickens attacks, casting and movement (the allies' share is dropped).

keenHalo.note: An aura that reserves mana and gives accuracy and critical strike chance.

crushingHalo.note: An aura that reserves mana: the character's physical damage rises (the enemies' vulnerability near the character is folded into more damage).

warden.note: An aura that reserves mana and gives resistance to all elements.

emberWard.note: An aura that reserves mana and gives fire resistance and maximum fire resistance.

frostWard.note: An aura that reserves mana and gives cold resistance and maximum cold resistance.

stormWard.note: An aura that reserves mana and gives lightning resistance and maximum lightning resistance.

vitalHalo.note: An aura that reserves mana and regenerates life.

fervorHalo.note: An aura that reserves mana: more spell damage and critical strike chance (the consecrated ground is dropped).

maliceHalo.note: An aura that reserves mana: more damage over time and longer ailments.

duneStance.note: A stance with no reservation: the two stances are averaged into more melee area damage.

stoneStance.note: A stance with no reservation: the two stances are averaged into less damage taken from hits.

rimePlate.note: An aura that reserves mana and cuts the damage taken from hits (the chill on attackers is dropped).

searingMantle.note: A burning aura with no reservation: the enemies near burn for a fifth of the character's life a second; the character burns for nine tenths of its life a second as fire damage that its fire resistance and energy shield answer to, and never dies of it; more spell damage.

cinderHerald.note: An aura that reserves mana: physical damage gained as fire, and ignites spread from enemies killed while burning (the overkill burn is dropped).

rimeHerald.note: An aura that reserves mana: added cold damage, and frozen enemies shatter in an icy burst when killed.

stormHerald.note: An aura that reserves mana: added lightning damage, and killing a shocked enemy calls down bolts on the enemies around the character for six seconds.

sourHerald.note: An aura that reserves mana: a chance to poison and more poison damage (the scorpion minion is dropped).

thunderRebuke.note: A strike with a mace, sceptre or staff that is half lightning, with a chance to shock (the aura for allies is dropped).

standingCast.note: The supported spell is cast by a totem that stands where it was put, using the character's numbers, a little slower and a little weaker.

standingBow.note: The supported ranged attack is fired by up to three ballista totems, each slower and weaker than the character.

setSnare.note: The supported skill is thrown as a trap that goes off when an enemy steps close, faster to throw and a little stronger.

chainedCharges.note: The supported skill is laid as mines that go off together, each weaker.

heavyCharge.note: The supported skill is laid as a mine that hits harder against enemies near mines, at less base damage.

snareCluster.note: Three traps are thrown at once, each weaker.

fieldOfCharges.note: Five mines are laid at once, much slower and each at the usual strength.

tripleSnare.note: Three traps are thrown at once, each weaker.

totemChoir.note: Three totems stand at once, each weaker.

wiredHarm.note: More damage for traps and mines, thrown a little slower.

doubleSet.note: A trap or mine often comes with an extra one (modelled as one more at a time, at a small price in damage).

livewireSnares.note: Traps that go off may grant Insight or Fervour charges; Insight raises their critical multiplier.

livewireCharges.note: Mines that go off may grant Insight or Fervour charges; Insight raises their critical chance.

pyreTotem.note: A totem that throws three flaming projectiles at enemies near it, for eight seconds.

quakeTotem.note: A totem that sends out a shockwave of force around itself, for eight seconds.

cinderBond.note: A pair of totems that burn the enemies near them (the damage over time is folded into repeated fire hits).

fatherTotem.note: A totem that strikes enemies next to it with the character's weapon (the owner's attack speed bonus is dropped).

warchiefTotem.note: A totem that slams the ground beside it with the character's weapon.

mortarBow.note: Up to three ballista totems that rain fire arrows in an arc, using the character's bow.

lanceBow.note: Up to three ballista totems that fire piercing arrows with the character's bow.

scatterBow.note: Up to three ballista totems that fire a cone of arrows with added physical damage; an enemy can be hit by several of the arrows of one shot (one of two skills that can).

mendingTotem.note: A totem whose aura regenerates life for eight seconds (modelled as a guard buff cast when hurt).

lureTotem.note: A totem that draws the enemies' attention (modelled as a guard buff of less damage taken, cast when hurt).

jawsTrap.note: A trap that crushes the enemy that steps in it and holds it for as long as its hit was a share of the enemy's life, then leaves it shackled: slow, fading, and taking 15% more from traps and mines.

blazeTrap.note: A trap that bursts into a fire that burns the area for almost two seconds.

frostTrap.note: A trap that bursts into a cold blast.

shrapnelTrap.note: A trap that blasts in fire and then in several smaller blasts (modelled as repeats).

fireBreathTrap.note: A trap that breathes fire for three and a half seconds.

spireTrap.note: A trap that raises a spire that strikes the enemies near it with lightning for three and a half seconds.

boltTrap.note: A trap that bursts into a ring of lightning bolts, with a chance to shock.

rumbleTrap.note: A trap that sends a line of five physical eruptions in front of it.

drainTrap.note: A trap that chills the enemies near it with cold damage over time and gives the character life and mana from each enemy affected (folded into leech).

icicleCharge.note: A mine that shoots five icicles when it goes off.

mortarCharge.note: A mine that throws fire in a burst when it goes off.

stormCharge.note: A mine that bursts in lightning with a stronger shock.

smokeCharge.note: A mine whose smoke quickens the character and hides it for a few seconds (modelled as a buff cast when a pack is near).

doomSigil.note: A brand that attaches to an enemy and pulses fire around it every three-quarters of a second, with a strong ignite.

tempestSigil.note: A brand that attaches to an enemy and chains lightning from it to others near, every 0.6 seconds.

echoingBlow.note: The supported melee strike also strikes twice more at other targets near it (modelled as two repeats at slightly less damage).

rollingVolleys.note: The supported bow or wand attack fires three more projectiles, one after another, so all of them can hit the same enemy; each hits for about two thirds less and every projectile makes the attack take 5% longer.

dazzle.note: Hits can blind enemies (10% chance): a blinded enemy misses half of its attacks. A blind is not a curse.

guardBreaker.note: Enemies block less against the supported skill, and a blocked hit leaves the blocker Overpowered, a further 5% less able to block for four seconds, stacking.

rout.note: Hits can make normal monsters flee (and magic ones half the time); rare monsters do not flee.

wardSiphon.note: Hits restore energy shield, and the skill deals more damage while the character is on full energy shield.

refineGem.note: Raises the quality of the supported gem (modelled as a small increase in damage).

deepInsight.note: Lowers the mana cost multiplier of the supported gem group (modelled as a cost multiplier below one).

cindering.note: The supported attack deals more burning damage and ignites more often, adding fire damage.

wildfireSeed.note: Ignites spread to the enemies nearby when an ignited enemy is killed, and ignite damage rises.

lightheart.note: The supported skill costs less mana, gains an Insight charge each time it is used, and hits harder in critical strikes and in elemental damage with each charge held (the reference gem's own charge type is Insight here; its reset when much mana has been spent is not modelled).

swellingBlast.note: The supported area spell hits harder and wider, the charge-up between uses averaged into a flat bonus.

scavenger.note: More rarity of the items dropped by enemies killed while the supported skill is socketed.

briefBurst.note: Shorter zones and ailments for more damage.

lingeringEffect.note: Longer zones and ailments for less damage.

hamstring.note: Hits maim (30% chance, four seconds): a maimed enemy moves more slowly and takes more physical damage; the skill deals more physical damage.

twinShadow.note: A mirage of the archer fires with each attack, a little weaker and slower (modelled as one repeat of the attack).

veilCut.note: Critical strikes grant Elusive (modelled as a bonus to critical chance and multiplier for the supported skill).

fury.note: Melee hits grant Rage, which boosts attacks.

shatteringBlows.note: Blunt hits send a shockwave that hits the area (modelled as more melee damage in an area and a wider reach).

flankingCast.note: The supported area spell is cast again on both sides of the target (modelled as two repeats at less damage).

doubleRelease.note: The supported spell is cast again, at less damage per cast (the stored seals are averaged).

standingCurse.note: A curse under this support is no longer cast: it stands on every enemy the character hits, and reserves mana.

slayersEcho.note: Spells linked to the supported melee skill are cast when it kills.

reelingCast.note: Spells linked to the supported spell are cast when the character has taken a heavy blow (a stun is approximated by a large hit).

chargeRelease.note: A nova around the character whose damage grows with the charges held: fire per Grit, cold per Fervour, lightning per Insight and the charges are spent when it lands. The character casts it once it holds at least three.

rotDrainTrap.note: A variant of the drain trap that deals chaos damage over time to the enemies near it and feeds the character.

raiseHusk.note: Raises zombies (3 to 7) that follow the character and slam enemies; they have life, are hurt by enemy blows and area attacks, and are raised again when the skill is cast after they fall.

callBonewalkers.note: Summons a group of skeletons (3 to 8) that run at enemies and last twenty seconds.

callFuries.note: Summons burning spirits (3 to 8) that rush at enemies for five seconds.

blightColossus.note: A chaos golem that fights beside the character and lowers the physical damage taken.

hallowedRelic.note: A relic that follows the character, shoots at enemies and regenerates the character's life.

whirringMotes.note: Two motes that follow the character and make shocks and chills stronger (the auras on enemies are folded into the character's ailment effect).

bindShade.note: Raises one or two bound shades that follow the character and fire chaos bolts at enemies (Bob's shades stand in for the reference's raised monsters).

wakeBlades.note: Animates a few blades that fight for the character for a long while.

wakeSentinel.note: Animates a guardian that fights beside the character.

hardyPack.note: The supported minions have more life.

brittleMoonring.note: Energy shield and fire resistance paid for by cold resistance. Basing stun threshold on energy shield is approximated as a lowered stun threshold.

tidalSceptre.note: Huge physical damage, speed and crit with half converted to lightning. The sixteen second overload and resolute technique cycle is written with the existing overload state (after a recent critical strike): more elemental damage while it is active, and increased physical damage while it is not.

ashenFetish.note: All attributes and strongly increased minion damage. The skeleton fire lines (ash on hit, fire damage taken, avatar of fire) are dropped.

polarSceptre.note: Elemental damage and cast speed. The cold and lightning damage gained per resistance above 75% is written as a flat increase to each.

veilcasterWard.note: Spell damage, intelligence and energy shield with no block chance. The blinded enemy bonuses are written flat (more fire damage); the reduced spell damage taken from blinded enemies and the trap smoke triggers are dropped.

wellburstWard.note: Mana, mana regeneration, mana on kill and flask mana recovery with spell damage. Sacrificing all mana on cast for added lightning damage is approximated as flat added maximum lightning damage to spells.

crimsonStandard.note: Life, armour and block on a tower shield. Leech against taunted enemies is written as flat attack life leech; the warcry cooldown speed and life on taunt lines are dropped (no taunt or warcry cooldown).

everfruitWard.note: Life and chaos resistance, with no block. The warcry triggered when losing endurance charges is written as a warcry cast after taking a heavy hit; the endurance charge and cooldown lines are dropped.

glarewand.note: Added physical and critical multiplier. The blinded enemy bonuses are written against nearby enemies (the reference aura blinds everything near you): huge crit chance and added fire damage to attacks. The granted blinding aura is dropped.

sunderStaff.note: Huge added physical damage, block and added physical to spells. The siphoning charges are written for a single always-on charge: added physical to attacks and spells, extra chaos damage, extra physical reduction and life leech. The physical damage taken per second is dropped.
